text_block_list.text:
One day, I come across Biwa<n>Hayahide in the
hallway, sighing at<n>her reflection in a window.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Ugh, I can't even get the sidesto settle down.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Same as ever, I'm afraid. Dealingwith another bad hair day. Andtoday's humidity has made things particularly bad. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to always ask, but would<n>you mind taking
a look at the back,<n>Tick—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry! Please, don't worry about<n>me. I thought
you were Ticket, for a<n>moment.

Biwa Hayahide wanders off, still<n>sighing all the
while.
